article: WindowsにGemini CLIをインストールする方法
findings: Removed duplicate/conflicting publication-date metadata across all editions, preserved the original 2025-07-13 publication date, and set lastmod to 2026-11-23.
Updated requirements from the current official guide: Node.js 20.0.0+, Windows 11 24H2+ as the recommended environment, PowerShell, and internet access.
Replaced the misleading npx-as-install procedure with the persistent npm global install flow and explained npx as an on-demand, non-global alternative.
Added first-run authentication choices and caveats for account-dependent availability, quotas, pricing and terms; documented global npm PATH troubleshooting and approval safety for file/shell tools.
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations. Compared setup commands, requirements, authentication, npx/global behavior, Windows PATH notes, and tool-security statements with current official primary documentation.
